source.author: verg
source.text: Infindunt pariter sulcos, totumque dehiscit convulsum remis rostrisque tridentibus aequor.
source.text_original: Infindunt pariter sulcos, totumque dehiscit / convulsum remis rostrisque tridentibus aequor.
source.text_english: They furrow the sea side by side, and the whole expanse gapes open, torn apart by the oars and the triple-pronged beaks.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ecce autem molli Zephyros descendere lapsu aspiciunt; volat immissis cava pinus habenis infinditque salum et spumas vomit aere tridenti:
reuse.text_original: ecce autem molli Zephyros descendere lapsu / aspiciunt; volat immissis cava pinus habenis / infinditque salum et spumas vomit aere tridenti: /
reuse.text_english: But behold, they see the Zephyrs descending with a gentle glide; the hollow pine flies, with reins let loose, cleaves the sea and spews forth foam through the trident-shaped air:
